announcements.author: OSAS Administration
announcements.summary: Official university schedule for First Semester A.Y. 2026-2027.
announcements.body:
Dear Student Body,

Please be advised that the Midterm Examinations for the First Semester will take place from October 12, 2026 to October 17, 2026.

Important Reminders and Campus Protocols

  1. Student Identification: Physical or Digital OSAS Pass IDs must be presented at all examination rooms.
  2. Arrival Time: Students must arrive at least 15 minutes before their scheduled examination. Laboratory clearances must be updated prior to the examination week.
  3. Examination Permits: Download your digitized examination permits via the OSAS Portal Student Dashboard.

For specific room assignments and your examination schedule, please refer to the attached PDF schedule document below.

Regards,
Office of Student Affairs Administration

regulations.title: Revised Student Code of Conduct and Disciplinary Procedures
regulations.approvalBody: Board of Trustees — Committee on Student Affairs
regulations.summary: This Code defines the standards of student behaviour, the classification of minor and major offenses, and the disciplinary procedures observed by the university.
regulations.body:
Article I — Coverage and Scope

This policy governs all officially enrolled students of the Southway College of Technology campuses, including students on practicum, internship, or any off-campus academic engagement.

Article II — Policy Statement

This Code defines the standards of student behaviour, the classification of minor and major offenses, and the disciplinary procedures observed by the university.

Article III — Implementing Guidelines

  • All students are duty-bound to read and observe the provisions of "Revised Student Code of Conduct and Disciplinary Procedures".
  • Violations shall be evaluated by the Office of Student Affairs and Services through due process.
  • Sanctions shall be proportionate to the offense and consistent with existing university regulations.
  • Reports and cases shall be documented and retained in accordance with the data privacy policy.

Article IV — Effectivity

This policy takes effect on September 15, 2025 and shall remain in force until otherwise revised by the Board of Trustees through a formal policy bulletin.

sanctions.text: Formal written warning + a required reflection to be submitted within three (3) working days.
Parent/Guardian + Dean notification and a written community service assignment.
Suspension from academic privileges for one (1) academic semester.

broadcasts.subject: Invitation: Annual Student Organization Recruitment for 2026
broadcasts.message: All accredited student organizations will hold recruitment activities from September 25 to 27. Visit the Activity Center to sign up.

broadcasts.subject: System Maintenance: Student Portal Temporary Outage
broadcasts.message: The Student Portal will be temporarily unavailable on September 10 from 10:00 PM to 11:00 PM for a scheduled database upgrade.

broadcasts.subject: Health Advisory: Annual Medical Clearance Verification
broadcasts.message: Please submit your physical examination results to the University Health Clinic prior to enrollment. Walk-in schedules are open daily.

broadcasts.subject: URGENT: Campus Weather Advisory & Class Suspension
broadcasts.message: All classes in both the Southway College of Technology campuses are suspended starting 3:30 PM today due to severe weather conditions.

broadcasts.subject: Reminder: Mandatory Orientation Completion Deadline
broadcasts.message: Portal access will be temporarily restricted for incoming freshmen who have not completed the orientation modules within thirty days of enlistment.

broadcasts.subject: Scholarship & Financial Assistance Application Open
broadcasts.message: OSAS is now accepting scholarship grants for Academic Year 2026-2027. Submit your requirements on or before September 30.

lostFound.title: Black leather wallet with a student ID inside
lostFound.description: A black leather wallet was turned over to the OSAS office. It contains a student ID and several receipts. The owner must describe the ID number and the wallet contents when claiming.

claims.proof: Student ID 23-00872 and a photo of the wallet taken before it was lost
claims.message: This is my wallet. It has my student ID inside and the receipts are from the bookstore last September 14.

lostFound.title: Blue Casio FX-991EX scientific calculator
lostFound.description: Found on the second floor of the Engineering Building after the 7:30 AM class. The name "J. Gomez" is written on the back cover.

lostFound.title: Silver iPhone 13 with a cracked screen protector
lostFound.description: Lost between the canteen and the College of Business Administration building during the lunch break. The lock screen shows a photo of a black cat.

lostFound.title: Student ID card — 24-01455
lostFound.description: The ID card slipped out of my uniform pocket while I was reviewing in the library. It has a blue lanyard attached.

lostFound.title: Set of keys with a maroon lanyard
lostFound.description: Found near the bleachers after the PE class. The set has three keys and a small flashlight keychain.

claims.proof: Student ID 24-01455 and the PE class schedule
claims.message: These are my keys — the small flashlight keychain was a gift from my org.

lostFound.title: Brown prescription eyeglasses in a black case
lostFound.description: Turned over by a student after the general assembly. The case has a small sticker of the College of Nursing.

claims.proof: Student ID 26-00017 and a photo wearing the eyeglasses
claims.message: The eyeglasses are mine. The black case has the Nursing Society sticker because my sister lent it to me.
I think these are mine. I lost a similar pair last week.

lostFound.title: Intermediate Accounting Volume 2 textbook
lostFound.description: Left on the reading table on the second floor. The inside cover has a handwritten name that is partially erased.

lostFound.title: Navy blue Jansport backpack
lostFound.description: Left under the table at the Activity Center during the organization fair. It contains two notebooks, a pencil case and a blue tumbler.

lostFound.title: Nursing uniform jacket, size medium
lostFound.description: Found draped over a chair in the lobby. The name tag has been removed, but a small pin from the Nursing Society is attached.

lostFound.title: USB flash drive with thesis drafts
lostFound.description: A silver 32 GB flash drive with a red cap. It holds the chapter drafts for my capstone project. Last used at the CCS laboratory.

lostFound.title: Clear water bottle covered with stickers
lostFound.description: Left at the canteen after the lunch rush. The bottle has travel stickers and a name written in marker that has faded.

lostFound.title: PE uniform shirt with embroidered initials
lostFound.description: Lost during the intramurals. Already recovered and turned over to the owner, so this report is kept for records only.

lostFound.title: Black wireless earbuds case
lostFound.description: The charging case fell out of my pocket somewhere between the canteen and the CCS building. Only the case is missing; the earbuds are with me.

lostFound.title: Blue ID lace with the SCT logo
lostFound.description: Found on the floor near the registrar's window. No ID card is attached, only the lace and a small clear sleeve.
